value.rationale: This is a complete natural n=3 positivity classification, sharp at q=2,3,4,5 and in the binary first nonunit layer. It gives finite all-target boundaries far stronger than the asymptotic guarantees, and exhibits non-monotonicity of coverage when changing from distinct pairs to triples in F5. The ring-length exceptions are structural, not arbitrary parameter slices.
